description: This file defines a class `em_cmd_start_dpp_t` derived from `em_cmd_t`, representing a command to start DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol) in the software project. It includes a constructor to initiate this command with given parameters and contains license and include guard headers.

classes.name: em_cmd_start_dpp_t
classes.description: A class representing the 'start DPP' command, inheriting from `em_cmd_t`, with a constructor to initialize the command with parameters.

methods.name: em_cmd_start_dpp_t
methods.description: Constructor that starts the DPP command with the specified parameters.
